The compost heap can be built in the [[kitchen garden]] to prepare valuable [[peat]] from [[crop waste]]. As a side product, you also get some [[maggot]]s from this process. You've got to study [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|"Decay" technology]] in advance.

If you want to know more details what to do with [[peat]], check the [[fertilizer]] page.
